note: Approved render-environment classes for the Blender lane, and the pinned tolerances (docs/BLENDER.md, Determinism). Kept apart from config/blender.json so that approving a class never changes the render config hash a class is defined by. Same class: lossless frames byte-identical. Different approved classes: bounded equivalence (character crops and full-scene frames separately). A crop sequence against its full-frame reference: bounded equivalence of the final 1920x1080 composites. Each limit is the worst value measured on 2026-10-18 times the margin stated beside it.
